adaptations.reason: First executable Windows run reached pytest but failed before test collection because pytest was not installed from requirements.txt.
adaptations.fix: Install requirements-qa.txt, run repository-native tests/native_acceptance.py first, then run full pytest.

adaptations.reason: Second executable Windows run reached application acceptance and exposed a stale test assumption: agency-01 participation expired on 2026-10-03, so direct agency management correctly returned FORBIDDEN_SCOPE on 2026-10-06.
adaptations.fix: Use the event organizer for event-wide admin acceptance, verify organizer access to another participant site, and verify organizer denial against platform scope. Authorization lifecycle behavior remains unchanged.

adaptations.reason: Third executable Windows run passed every functional native-acceptance check but the test process failed during temporary-directory cleanup because Windows still held db.sqlite briefly after the server process exited.
adaptations.fix: Keep the functional behavior unchanged; after server termination, explicitly verify SQLite file-handle release with bounded rename retries before TemporaryDirectory cleanup.

adaptations.reason: A later Windows run proved the SQLite acceptance repair but exposed three independent full-suite regressions: demo participation access depended on expired fixed dates, Windows default text decoding used CP1252 for UTF-8 assets, and the local backup helper left SQLite handles open during temporary cleanup.
adaptations.fix: Keep permanent seeded demo memberships clock-stable, use explicit/forced UTF-8 text mode, explicitly close backup SQLite connections, and add regression coverage for future-clock demo access.

adaptations.reason: The repaired exact application head passed the complete Windows gate.
adaptations.fix: Evidence only: isolated native acceptance passed 33 checks including sqlite_handle_released; full repository pytest passed 168 tests. No PostgreSQL/offline-soak/load/security/UAT/production promotion is inferred.
